summary: This rule tells the web server to permanently redirect any request for /old.php to a new URL at http://www.yoursite.com/new.php. Browsers and search engines will remember this redirect and update their bookmarks or records accordingly.

explanations.1: RedirectPermanent sends an HTTP 301 status code, which means 'this page has moved permanently' — the strongest signal to browsers and search engines to update their records and always go to the new location in the future.
